blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Police arrested a 39-year-old teacher in an entrapment operation after she allegedly tried to sell a parcel of land for P500,000 using falsified land titles in the town of Pili in Camarines Sur. The sting operation was conducted on Wednesday at 4:15 p.m. in front of a bank in Barangay Santiago after the prospective buyer reported the suspected fraud, said Police Lt. Col. Jabesh Napolis, Pili police chief.
